title: The day the check arrives
hook: Two stated cases: explore the cash remaining across a payment cycle.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the cash remaining across a payment cycle affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Remaining, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the cash remaining across a payment cycle in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
